name: Moderation Team
description: Adds team-based functionality to content moderation.
project_description:
Use this module if your site receives an overwhelming number of submissions. It lets a team share the moderation effort among trusted users.

 The Moderation Team module currently handles nodes, but all entity types (comments, user accounts, webforms, custom entities, etc.) are on the roadmap. 

 What the Moderation Team module does 
 Users designated as moderators get their own list of submissions. Rather than having the entire team work from a single queue of new submissions, moderators can then work toward 'inbox 0' in their own queue. The module removes worries of team members duplicating each other's efforts. When the number of moderators changes (by adding or removing a role), the length of queues is adjusted to re-share the list of submissions evenly.
